title: AH White: Walking Banks

prize.note: split across two P2WPKH addresses derived from one published xpub, funded 2024-09-05

target_format: BIP39 24 words (English), empty passphrase, account key matching the published xpub (native SegWit, BIP84)

derivation.summary: derive the account-0 extended key (BIP84/44/49/86, empty passphrase) for a candidate 24-word mnemonic and compare its compressed public key and chain code to the published xpub
derivation.certified_against: the published xpub's own derivation of the two known treasure addresses, plus the public 24-word BIP39 test vector (all-zero entropy, checksum word 'art')

difficulty_note: the mechanism is fully understood and the published text has been mined exhaustively; only 1 of 6 organ-donor groups (4 of 24 words) is printed as a decodable block, and the other 5 are not present anywhere in the free PDF, the site text, or the audiobook narration, which argues the remaining words depend on hints the author has not yet published

leads.title: watch the Nostr feed for new hints
GPU completion of the last 4 words once 20 are known

sources.title: Walking Banks, official site (Find the Treasure)

third_party_material: no book pages, OCR text, or audiobook audio/transcripts are included; the one chapter 11 passage quoted in clues/author-posts.md is the short excerpt that carries the puzzle's own decoding rule
